title: ID0445720-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / S2 313522141001] Charging Station Is Out Of Service
description: Reported Behavior/ Issue: PTS DUFOUR charging station is out of service.

additional_info.subject: Technical Incident – PTS DUFOUR SiD Y2/S213522141001
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Since this past weekend, the PTS DUFOUR charging station has been out of service.
This morning at 6:00 a.m., both connectors were unavailable. Around 7:10 a.m., connector 2 (right side) came back online, but connector 1 (left side) is still out of service (see attached photo).
On the supervision platform, both connectors are shown as unavailable, even though communication with the charger is established.
Technical details:
•     Model: SICHARGE D
•     Serial number: Y2/S213522141001
•     Connector 1: unavailable since 24/08/2025 at 13:52
•     Connector 2: displayed as available locally, but marked unavailable in supervision
Please investigate the root cause of this issue and schedule the necessary corrective actions to restore full availability.
I will be out on deliveries this morning and back on-site in the afternoon if any on-site checks are required.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0445720-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / S2 313522141001] Charging Station Is Out Of Service CRM:02699000209
additional_info.body:
Bonjour Malek,
Le chargeur est actuellement totalement disponible (les deux connecteurs). Le problème provenait d’une perte de communication entre le PLC et le SECC. Un redémarrage de la borne a permis de résoudre le problème.
La version V8.0.5 corrige définitivement ce défaut de communication. Si vous le souhaitez, je vous recommande d’en faire la demande auprès de la région France.
Je vais procéder à la fermeture du ticket, mais je reste bien entendu à votre disposition pour tout renseignement complémentaire.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL

o not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
